title: Formal Painleve-I isomonodromy equations for the logarithmic WKB series constructed by topological recursion away from t zero
author: Kohei Iwaki; Axel Saenz
source_title: Quantum Curve and the First Painlevé Equation
difficulty_reason: The proof must add the residue at the double turning point to the differential recursion and relate its principal specialization to both logarithmic isomonodromy equations. A coupled induction establishes the Riccati coefficients, time evolution and closed free-energy derivative together, using holomorphicity at the double turning point to close each step. This all-orders construction exceeds computing initial WKB coefficients or applying topological recursion formally.

statement_scope: Select only the two explicitly stated formal logarithmic equations3.6-3.7 of author Theorem3.3 for S=sum hbar^(m-1)S_m, with explicit S0=(4/5)(x-3q0)(x+2q0)^(3/2), S1=-(1/4)log(x+2q0), and higher S_m from stable integrated Eynard-Orantin differentials. q0^2=-t/6 on a chosen branch over a domain excluding t=0, x=z^2-2q0,y=2z(z^2-3q0), and q(t,hbar),p=hbar dq/dt are the author zero-parameter formal PI solution. Retain formal/meromorphic scope; no convergence or Borel summation claim. The printed exp(S t) wave-function3.4 and unregularized unstable-integral shorthand are not selected.
